 Order
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

3. The present Writ Petition has been filed with the following prayer:-
"

Under the above circumstance, it is therefore humbly prayed that this Hon'ble Court be graciously pleased to issue a writ in the nature of writ of mandamus or any other appropriate writ, direction or order to the Opp. Parties more particularly Special Land Acquisition Officer, Balangir, "herein referred as opp. Party No.4" to take decision on the representation dt.13.12.2022 under Annexure-3 with regard prayer for proper initiation in the matter of payment of compensation and separate entity along with allotment of Ac.0.10 dec. of lands for residential purpose to each displaced family under the prescribed scheme for construction of Lower Suktel Irrigation Project, Balangir in favour of the Petitioners, as they have no means of livelihood after the acquisition of their land, within a stipulated time fixed by the Hon'ble Court.
And be pleased to pass any other order/orders as deemed fit and proper in the circumstances of the case.
And for this act of kindness the petitioner shall ever pray. "

sentences.text:
In course of hearing, learned counsel for the Petitioner states that highlighting their grievances,
the Petitioner has made representation to Opposite Party No.4 vide Annexure-3 series and the same may be directed to be considered within a stipulated time, to which learned Counsel for the State has no objection.

5. As agreed by learned counsel for the parties and after going through the records, this Court,
without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, disposes of the Writ Petition directing Opposite Party No.4 to consider the representation filed by the petitioner vide Annexure-3 series,
and pass appropriate order in accordance with law within a period of three months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
Issue urgent certified copy as per Rules.

(DR. B.R. SARANGI) JUDGE (M.S. RAMAN) JUDGE Laxmikant Signed by: LAXMIKANT MOHAPATRA Location: HIGH COURT OF ORISSA, CUTTACK Date: 18-May-2023 17:32:15 Rameswar Sahu & Others vs State Of Odisha & Others ..... Opposite ... on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/77811275/
